svg.aria-label: Autocomplete architecture in two lanes. Data gathering, offline and rebuilt weekly: analytics logs are aggregated into weekly query counts, workers build the trie from them and store it in the trie database. Query service, on every keystroke: the user's request goes through a load balancer to API servers, then a filter layer that removes unsafe suggestions, to an in-memory trie cache that takes a weekly snapshot of the trie database and is refilled from it on a miss.
svg.title: Autocomplete architecture
